# Rebecca Node 1.7.1

Rebecca Node 1.7.1 applies inbound and routing changes without restarting Xray, cleans up stale Xray processes whose binary was replaced, and skips speed-limit reconciles when the plan has not changed. It keeps node operations aligned with Rebecca 1.8.1.

## Highlights

- 🔁 **Inbound and routing changes without a restart** — when the panel changes inbounds or routing rules, the node applies them at runtime and Xray keeps running.
- 🧹 **Stale Xray cleanup** — Xray processes whose binary was replaced are cleaned up.
- ⚡ **Fewer speed reconciles** — the node skips reconciling speed limits when the speed-limit plan is unchanged.

## Reliability and compatibility

- Duplicated VPN runtime user types and TSV writers are merged. The file formats are unchanged.
- No configuration, certificate or database changes are needed.

## Upgrade notes

> Upgrade Rebecca and Rebecca Node together. Nodes on 1.7.0 can update in place, and no configuration changes are needed.
